items: A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety shoes, 
 helmet breathing mask, safety glasses
The circuit breaker should be switched off. and fully isolated.
The earthing switch must be closed on both sides of the breaker
Switch off control current for CB (d.c)
Complete set of tools, rags, Blower
Inspect and clean out the compressor air filter.
Drain and refill compressor sump with air compressor lubricant.

Check the compressor safety valve for correct operation manually lifting the 
 valve plungre and lefting the plunger close by itself

Check the pressure drop caused by the safety valve operation and by the 
 subsequent air pressure recovery as follows:
 * The operating points of all pressure-operated contacts 63,63L,63AL, and 63R
 * The pressure at which the safety valve recloses
 * The compressor pump-up time

Make sure that all contact circuit terminals and auxiliary switch contacts are 
 clean and tightened,

With control circuits de-energized, make sure that all pivot pins of the 
 bistable spring devise and the auxiliary contact links of each pole are clane 
 and lubricated If necessary, clean out, inspect and re-lubricate the pins, 
 using MP MOLYSLIP grease.

With control and indicator circuits energized, check the operating pressure of 
 the gas alarm and interlock contacts 63GAL and 63G of the gas pressure gauge, 
 by loosening and refightening the pressure gauge coupling so as to produce a 
 transient, iocal pressure drop sufficient to close and re-open the gauge 
 contacts and whether the operating pressures comply with the assigned values.
If nessary, refill each breaker pole with SF6 gas
Useing soapsuds, make sure that the gauge couplings are gas-tight again

Introduction
This
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases or every 200 
compressor operating hours, whichever occurs first 
as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

first draft initiated at Rabt Aswan 220kv substation upper Egypt zone ECET.
Safety Precautions

Switch on the ventilation.
